General knowledge of the UCSC campus. Familiarity with university programs, administrative units, and a range of student services. Experience with UCSC computing applications or equivalent: AIS, EAB / Slug Success, OCA, Infoview, CCLP, CruzPay, WCMS, StudentERSystem.
Experience recruiting, interviewing, selecting and supervising student employees.

Using skills as a seasoned, experienced academic advisor, the Environmental Studies Undergraduate Program Coordinator leads all undergraduate advising in the Environmental Studies Department (ENVS), and assists with our expansive internship program. Under the general supervision of the ENVS Department Manager, the incumbent has full programmatic responsibility for the independent administration of ENVS undergraduate advising, including advising faculty and management on the full range of academic issues. The incumbent will serve as the lead administrative member on several of our internal committees, including our curriculum planning committee and our awards and scholarships committee. The incumbent works with the Office of Campus Advising Coordination to incorporate changes to department advising policies, practices, and procedures.
Through knowledge of advising and counseling techniques.
Knowledge of departmental / school / college courses and majors.
Skills in judgment, decision-making, and problem-solving.
Knowledge of department / school / college policies, procedures, and requirements.
Abilities in problem identification, reasoning, and ability to develop original ideas to solve problems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including active listening.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
